description: Implementation of ShoppingCartService handling shopping cart operations such as retrieval, update, merging, and price calculations in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ShoppingCartServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for shopping cart operations, extending generic entity service and implementing shopping cart specific logic.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart for a customer, populating its details and removing if obsolete.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a shopping cart based on its ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a shopping cart by ID, optionally with store context, and populates its details.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart by code and store, populating details and removing if obsolete.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart associated with a customer.

methods.name: populateShoppingCart
methods.description: Populates shopping cart items with current product data and prices.

methods.name: populateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Creates a shopping cart item from a product, calculating price and setting attributes.

methods.name: createShippingProduct
methods.description: Creates shipping product list from shopping cart items.

methods.name: isFreeShoppingCart
methods.description: Checks if all items in the cart are free.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if the cart requires shipping based on product attributes.

methods.name: mergeShoppingCarts
methods.description: Merges two shopping carts, combining items and updating quantities.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart items from a session cart, ensuring product validity.
